verdict.rationale: Portkey publishes an API reference section with a documented REST base URL (`https://api.portkey.ai/v1`). Its gateway features are driven through that API by changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers, which works with existing OpenAI SDKs, so the core product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence of management/admin endpoints (configs, logs, keys, budgets) beyond inference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
